scenes.name: hook
scenes.text: You roll up to a toll plaza, the barrier lifts, and you barely slow down. No cash, no card. But what actually happens?

scenes.name: tag
scenes.text: That FASTag sticker has a tiny chip and an antenna inside. No battery. It just stores a unique tag ID.

scenes.name: read
scenes.text: An antenna above the lane sends out radio waves. They power the chip, and it reflects its ID back.

scenes.name: plaza
scenes.text: The plaza system looks up your vehicle class, car, bus or truck, and works out the toll. A camera also snaps your number plate.

scenes.name: netc
scenes.text: It sends the request to its bank, which passes it through NPCI's toll network, to the bank that issued your tag.

scenes.name: debit
scenes.text: Your bank checks the tag is valid and has balance, then debits the toll. Approved goes back the same way.

scenes.name: gate
scenes.text: The barrier lifts, usually within seconds, and an SMS confirms the deduction.

scenes.name: outro
scenes.text: Radio tag, reader, banks, barrier. Done while you roll. Follow for more on how things really work.
